kind: Independent offline semantic custody review; no credit ledger write
reason: The complete funnel consumer adds a real live full-fit insertion-versus-world-spawn delivery policy, but no independent saved material owner, pending delivery journal, restored progress, schema conversion or replay/recovery mechanism is present in this file/base. Shared request/matcher/extraction code already supports accepted retainer/cube mechanisms. Additional delivery branching and platform insertion internals are useful boundary evidence, not enough alone to count another migration family. This is not a claim the funnel and cube are textually or behaviorally identical.

candidate_integrity.limit: Different AST fingerprint or class name does not establish semantic credit.

provenance.limit: Fixed acquired local Java snapshot and original candidate hashes only. No network/archive/tree/blob-to-commit revalidation; exact target native version and platform service registration unverified.

actual_findings.finding: Rising redstone edge writes POWERED=true then invokes doRequest; falling clears. No explicit side guard here; native callback execution sides unproven. Master spark/nonempty filter required. Facing frames select weighted stack; rotation selects1/2/4/8/16/32/48/64, original filter count is weight. Not an independent durable paid-progress owner.

Matcher checks nonempty same item and checkNBT policy. Non-mana compares item/tags. If both recognized mana items, compare empty/partial/full bucket, then copy and clear mana before ItemStack.matches. Therefore checkNBT=true does not guarantee exact mana quantity or every original value. Native matches count semantics and mana adapter effects are not further audited; no guaranteed equivalence claim.

Cancellable event precedes network iteration. Interceptors run before/after extraction. doit=true invokes extraction and returns node stacks. Request satisfied count decremented BEFORE actual extraction, extracted count increments requested rem rather than measured return. Forge passes creative flag as simulate; Vanilla creative returns copies. Ordinary vanilla removes and marks changed. Counters/creative returned stacks therefore cannot establish actual survival inventory debit or destination receipt.

Destination is selected once BEFORE upstream extraction; upper inventory below1 takes priority over below2. No second-destination capacity search after first chosen. For each returned stack, simulate only tests FULL acceptance. If simulation fails even partly, whole original stack enters spawn branch; no partial insert here. On full simulation, actual insert remainder is only checkEmpty logged, no refund/fallback/retry/persisted custody record. Spark onItemsRequested callback precedes delivery and is not a delivery acknowledgement.

checkEmpty only warns. World ItemEntity is created at spark location, addFreshEntity boolean ignored; no recovery path verified. Do not claim actual loss/duplication reproduced, successful acquisition or crash-atomic save.

hasInventory checks item capability or WorldlyContainerHolder, but insert fallback wrapper is considered only when BE is null; a holder with BE but absent cap is not automatically wrapped by this code. Simulation and untagged execution use ItemHandlerHelper. SINGLE_ITEM_INSERT actual execution loops copies of1 and mutates toInsert count; simulation always uses bulk helper. Contract/handler differences can break assumed equivalence; no blanket prediction of failure, native helper not audited.

Each call looks up storage and opens its own outer Transaction; only execution commits. Tagged insertion uses one-item calls in both simulation and execution. Returned leftover is computed from inserted count. This per-call transaction does NOT include upstream network extraction or the prior simulated call; no end-to-end transaction proven.

dedup.actual_consumer: Retainer remember stores position/matcher/count, dirty; fulfil retains request while spark/requestor absent; invokes requestor then forgets and dirties regardless of fulfilled amount. read restores registered matcher or null. Its independent durable owner is deferred request, not guaranteed paid delivery. Funnel can be its requestor consumer but owns no new pending payload here.
dedup.opinion: Funnel evidence supports limits of previously accepted deferred chain; no new credit for tracing shared request execution.

dedup.actual_consumer: Cube saves requestTarget/count/locked/hideCount, copies authored filter to count1, recounts20ticks, and live request calls same helper then spawns each returned stack with ignored addFreshEntity; cached count subtracts actual returned matching item counts regardless of spawn acknowledgement. Funnel differs by conditional full-fit destination insertion but not by a new durable request/material restoration mechanism.
dedup.opinion: Real delivery-policy distinction acknowledged; treat as boundary support for shared network custody, not a second migration family solely for destination choice/platform adapters.
